definitions.explanation: A measured value that falls outside the normal or expected range. Used in medicine, science, data analysis, and technical fields.

examples.japanese: ⟦{血液|けつえき}{検査|けんさ}→血液検査：23299_ketsuekikensa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{異常値|いじょうち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: An abnormal value came up in the blood test.

examples.japanese: {異常値|いじょうち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{検出|けんしゅつ}→検出：13132_kenshutsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{再検査|さいけんさ}→再検査：23339_saikensa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: A reexamination is needed because an abnormal value was detected.

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{異常値|いじょうち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めて→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check the data for outliers before beginning the analysis.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧ (abnormal) and {値|ち} (value, reading). This word is encountered frequently in medical contexts, where blood tests and health checkups may reveal values outside the normal range, as well as in scientific and data analysis contexts.

In Japanese health checkups (⟦{健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧), results are typically classified as ⟦{正常|せいじょう}→正常：03085_seijou⟧ (normal), ⟦{要|よう}→要：10000_you⟧⟦{経過|けいか}{観察|かんさつ}→経過観察：09019_keikakansatsu⟧ (requires monitoring), or ⟦{要|よう}→要：10000_you⟧⟦{精密|せいみつ}{検査|けんさ}→精密検査：20629_seimitsukensa⟧ (requires further examination) based on whether values fall within or outside expected ranges.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {異常値|いじょうち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: for an abnormal value to appear
- {異常値|いじょうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to show an abnormal value
- {異常値|いじょうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検出|けんしゅつ}→検出：13132_kenshutsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to detect an outlier
- {異常値|いじょうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{除外|じょがい}→除外：16375_jogai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exclude outliers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {正常値|せいじょうち}: normal value — the opposite; a reading within the expected range
- {基準値|きじゅんち}: reference value, standard value — the benchmark against which abnormality is judged
- ⟦{外|はず}れ→外れ：10487_hazure⟧{値|ち}: outlier — used primarily in statistics and data science
